subject.title: [Feature]: Audio file support in read tool (multimodal parity with images)

question: Should OpenClaw add native audio as a first-class read-tool and LLM content type, or keep read() text/image-only and route audio through transcription/media-understanding workflows?
rationale: The requested behavior changes provider payload shape, model capability routing, local-file egress, auth/security boundaries, and session transcript semantics, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Design native audio contract first
options.body: Add typed audio content only after maintainers approve provider capability gates, raw-media policy, transcript/audit behavior, and fallback semantics.

options.title: Keep read text/image-only
options.body: Leave read() unchanged and make audio use the existing transcription/media-understanding surfaces until a broader native media design lands.

options.title: Defer to broader native-media tracker
options.body: Treat #51667 or a new design issue as the canonical place for native audio/video model input and keep this as a read-tool-specific dependent request.

recommendation.title: Design native audio contract first
recommendation.body: Add typed audio content only after maintainers approve provider capability gates, raw-media policy, transcript/audit behavior, and fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses core/provider/security architecture, where recent history shows broad adjacent ownership.
